profile.headline: Experienced full stack / frontend software engineer applying my skills to climate change problems.

positions.title: Software Engineer, Search Platforms Team
positions.description: The Search Platforms Team worked on improving the speed and performance of the search results page. This included essential image and rendering optimizations, as well as creative UI changes to improve the user perception of latency. I worked on Soft/Express Transitions, a project to issue async requests for the next search results page on a refinement click (i.e. “People Also Search For”) and use javascript animation to seamlessly transition from one page to the next while pre-filling the next page with cached data.

positions.title: Software Engineer, Explore Team
positions.description: The Explore Team designed, prototyped, built, and ran experiments on new features for the search results page. Some features I worked on included PDF Previews (adding thumbnail preview images and metadata to PDF results) and Visual Web (updating the rendering for thumbnail images on individual web results on mobile search pages and experimenting with many other UI updates and interaction changes).

positions.title: Software Engineer, Web Team
positions.description: The Web Team managed all of Venmo’s web presence from venmo.com to webviews that appear within the native apps. Specific projects included rewriting the logged out payment links page, rewriting the settings pages, and rewriting the developer site using React and Redux as well as contributing to a full app rewrite in React/Redux.

positions.title: Tutor
positions.description: I tutored students for the SAT/ACT and provided subject specific support in math, chemistry, biology, physics, and environmental science.

positions.title: Computational Modeler
positions.description: Created and used computational models of cardiac electrophysiology to study the mechanisms of atrial fibrillation. Specifically, I created a patient specific model of atrial fibrillation using a 3D structure generated from CAT scan imaging of the patients heart, and electrical information from monophasic action potential catheter recordings. I then ran simulations and analyzed simulations aimed at fully understanding the spatial and electrical causes of atrial fibrillation in that specific patient. This research will hopefully soon provide justification for novel treatements of atrial fibrillation.

positions.title: Research in Industrial Projects for Students
positions.locationName: Institute for Pure and Applied Mathematics
positions.description: Improved the search capabilities of the USC Shoah Foundation Visual History Archive by incorporating a geo-semantic ranking algorithm into their existing interface.

volunteerExperiences.description: Helped the city of Airway Heights, WA send a survey to residents to assess the impact of Covid-19 on local residents and businesses.

I helped DataKind build an interactive web visualization of data from the non-profit DC Action for Children (http://datatools.dcactionforchildren.org/). My primary contribution was to create the line chart seen on the right that dynamically updates as you over over different neighborhoods. I used javascript's D3 library.
